summary: Extends the Path Computation Element Communication Protocol (PCEP) so a client can ask a path computation server to work out routes for point-to-multipoint traffic engineering label switched paths in MPLS and GMPLS networks. It was replaced by RFC 8306.

eli5.summary: One road to one place is easy to plan, but a delivery tree that branches to many places is harder. This lets a router ask a helper computer to plan that branching route.

questions: how to compute p2mp te lsp paths
